decision: Propose smallest first slice only, no source implementation
supersedes_first_slice: Stage1 larger metadata-thaw design is deferred; retain existing metadata decode and all MedicalAdmission double producer renewals / MedicalPublicationPlan rebuilds unchanged.
constructor: After actual producer result and complete existing verify_medical_revalidation success, create exact constructor-owned immutable witness binding three exact original bytes, actual complete result bytes, source/script/runtime selected identity and original descriptor/config correspondence. It is pure semantic evidence, never source/native/ACK authority.
renew: Execute existing _pin and _inputs and bounded result_file.read every time, including independent closing under finish. Check exact nominal/type/owner identity and all original bytes against witness. Only skip repeated verify_medical_revalidation when complete current typed bytes and selected witness identity still match. Verify cannot be skipped by mutating self.raw and self.originals together; both must independently equal constructor witness. No stat-only/hash-only gate.
keep_unchanged: Full bounded inputs/script/result bytes and file/parent identity checks
Producer callback ownership and MedicalAdmission call sequencing
metadata decode_medical complete current emitted result projection
tests: Complete constructor verify exactly once plus repeated renew all actualbyte/currentpin checks
Same-size changed raw/input bytes despite unchanged timestamps reject
Mutate self.raw/self.originals together with current file bytes reject against witness
Equal replacement witness/producer/config/script descriptor identity refuse where selected original identity required
Subclass/Boolean-numeric equality attempts reject before overload
Complete unknown/residual/provenance/decimal lexical bytes preserved through existing evidence/metadata
Cancellation or one closing refusal still attempts independent remaining checks and preserves primary
qualification: 116 metadata calls in one SDK-free fixture justify removing repeated pure verification; no native timing/bottleneck claim. Actual positive producer and full native recovery remain independently required.
